requirements_proved: All eleven frozen shared features have equal declared weight and one shared scorer produces both score and per-feature contributions.
Numeric q05/q95 ranges, categorical vocabularies, medians, modes, initialization, and k selection use FIT buyers only.
Missing or unknown values receive distance one and no coverage credit; coverage below 0.80 is explicitly invalid.
Inference distance saturates at one without clipping an input to a prototype or awarding false match credit.
The largest converged candidate with every support at least max(30, ceil(0.02*n_fit)) is selected; empty and undersupported candidates fail closed.
Multimodal groups survive as supported profiles while singleton outliers cannot become retained anchors.
Row order and assignment chunk size do not change the artifact; holdout and unrelated-product changes do not change fitting.
Relevant FIT-buyer changes change the artifact and resulting score.
A score of one requires an exact fully observed prototype match.
Canonical JSON artifacts have governed paths, atomic writes, checksums, bounded size, exact method/feature validation, and stale-source refusal.
Prototype payloads contain support and feature values but no internal customer identifiers or contact PII.

Profile claims and publication are owner/token fenced; publication verifies durable artifact bytes and latest sources in one transaction, exact retries reuse one published row, stale leases can be recovered, and cancellation fails closed.
A customer or campaign-sales source replacement between claim and publication marks the profile stale and publishes no artifact row.
Holdout output is explicitly customer-disjoint descriptive validation, not campaign-independent predictive evidence.
limitations: Buyer similarity is a method-specific descriptive index; 0.90 means distance at most 0.10, not 90 percent purchase likelihood, accuracy, confidence, percentile, or attribute match rate.
The 40-buyer holdout is customer-disjoint but not campaign-independent predictive validation; no AUC, lift, response, or purchase claim is made.

Stage 14B_03 builds, transactionally publishes, reloads, and reuses one bounded canonical product artifact in a disposable schema-32 registry. Runtime worker composition, full prospect scoring, and score-generation attestations belong to Stage 14B_04.
No 5M run, UI, export, scenario run, remote CI, commit, push, merge, or deployment was performed.
decision_reason: The exact declared distance mathematics, deterministic supported prototype fit, fit-only preprocessing, safe integrity-checked artifact, and leakage boundary are implemented and independently verified without changing v1/v2 behavior or canonical data.
